name: UK Biobank: AI applications and models policy
stated_condition: The researcher must determine whether a trained model could retrieve participant-level data, generate equivalent data, or substitute for access to participant-level data; if so, third-party release is not permitted. stated_condition: No model category. Application dates: secure processing environment implementing acts 2027-03-26, chapter IV from 2029-03-26 (Art. 105, per the survey agent).
source_title: Regulation (EU) 2025/327 on the European Health Data Space

name: EDPB Opinion 28/2024 on AI models
stated_condition: Reported by the survey agent: a model is anonymous only if extraction and query-based disclosure of personal data is insignificant for any data subject (paras 34, 43); evidence is the design, attack tests (para 55) and documentation (para 58); the depth of testing depends on whether the model is released publicly or used internally (para 46).
source_title: Opinion 28/2024 on certain data protection aspects related to the processing of personal data in the context of AI models

name: CNIL and ICO guidance on AI models

name: Korea: Personal Information Protection Act, Enforcement Decree and Notice 2025-8 (export by combination agencies)
stated_condition: Reported by the survey agent: no model category. A combination-specialised agency's export is decided by a three-person export review committee on purpose relevance, absence of identifiability and a safety plan (Act arts 28-3(2), 58-2; Decree art 29-3(4); Notice 2025-8 arts 10-12). An amendment effective 2027-03-09 (arts 28-12 to 28-15) adds AI-development use under Personal Information Protection Commission deliberation and is silent on export.
